cases.name: tau_provider_boundary_documented
cases.proves: Dogpile's skill contract names Tau, not direct SciLLM, as the model orchestration boundary.
cases.does_not_prove: Actual Dogpile synthesis execution through a Tau provider DAG.

cases.name: legacy_scillm_marked_migration
cases.proves: Existing direct SciLLM code is explicitly labeled as legacy migration work.
cases.does_not_prove: Removal of every legacy direct SciLLM call from implementation.

cases.name: brave_search_channel_documented
cases.proves: Brave is a first-class Dogpile web-search channel with query-budget rules.
cases.does_not_prove: Live Brave API credentials or result relevance.

cases.name: brave_questions_replace_perplexity
cases.proves: Perplexity replacement uses concurrent Brave question fan-out.
cases.does_not_prove: Live Brave search result quality.

cases.name: perplexity_retired_default_off
cases.proves: Perplexity is default-off and the deprecated flag is documented as skip-only.
cases.does_not_prove: Historical Perplexity API behavior.

cases.name: github_uses_brave_discovery
cases.proves: GitHub Search composes Brave and uses Brave discovery before executable repository evaluation.
cases.does_not_prove: Live GitHub auth or semantic repo ranking.

cases.name: github_security_repo_promotion_criteria
cases.proves: Dogpile documents security-specific GitHub repository promotion gates and requires isolated evaluation for untrusted security repos.
cases.does_not_prove: Live GitHub auth, exploit validity, detection quality, or repository safety.

cases.name: github_direct_search_supports_freshness_filters
cases.proves: GitHub Search exposes explicit freshness and star filters for current starred repository discovery.
cases.does_not_prove: Live GitHub result quality or whether any specific domain has matching repos this week.

cases.name: arxiv_channel_documented
cases.proves: ArXiv has a documented Dogpile channel and stage-2 hook.
cases.does_not_prove: Live ArXiv availability or full PDF extraction.

cases.name: youtube_brave_first_discovery
cases.proves: YouTube discovery defaults to Brave-first search with yt-dlp fallback and can extract video IDs from web results.
cases.does_not_prove: Live YouTube search availability, transcript availability, or Whisper quality.

cases.name: youtube_transcript_enrichment_default_off
cases.proves: Transcript enrichment is opt-in and Dogpile transcript fetches request transcript text without legacy enrichment.
cases.does_not_prove: A Tau-backed transcript enrichment adapter.

cases.name: fetcher_internal_primitive_documented
cases.proves: Fetcher is documented as a deep-fetch primitive after a concrete URL is selected.
cases.does_not_prove: Live fetch quality for every URL.

cases.name: context7_library_docs_opt_in
cases.proves: Context7 is documented and wired as an opt-in library/API documentation lane for code-related questions.
cases.does_not_prove: Live Context7 credential validity, quota, or documentation relevance.

cases.name: feeds_default_off_and_no_key_packs
cases.proves: Feeds are default-off and Dogpile documents credential requirements.
cases.does_not_prove: Live RSS freshness or parsing for every source.

cases.name: configured_rss_packs_require_no_api_keys
cases.proves: Configured Dogpile RSS pack source definitions contain no API-key/token fields.
cases.does_not_prove: Whether each public feed endpoint is reachable right now.

cases.name: darpa_routes_to_ops_darpa
cases.proves: Dogpile documents DARPA as a specialized opt-in lane owned by ops-darpa, including public RSS and Grants.gov no-key sources.
cases.does_not_prove: Live DARPA RSS freshness or Grants.gov query usefulness.

cases.name: battle_consumes_dogpile_as_design_input
cases.proves: Dogpile and Battle both document that Dogpile research feeds Battle strategy while Docker/QEMU/Judge gates own execution proof.
cases.does_not_prove: Live Battle orchestration, exploit success, patch effectiveness, or repository safety.

cases.name: feed_selection_guidance_is_actionable
cases.proves: Dogpile documents what each important feed/source excels at, when to activate it, and when not to use it.
cases.does_not_prove: Live freshness, article quality, or exact downstream source ranking.

cases.name: credentialed_api_references_documented
cases.proves: Dogpile documents credentialed API references, marks key enrichment sources optional, keeps SecurityTrails cost-prohibitive by default, and prefers public Malpedia GitHub before invite-only API access.
cases.does_not_prove: API key validity, paid-plan entitlement, or live API response quality.

cases.name: community_sources_manual_not_api_credentials
cases.proves: Dogpile treats Discord/Slack communities as manual sources, not API-key feeds or bot-readable providers.
cases.does_not_prove: Whether a human currently has membership in any community.

cases.name: shodan_scope_limits_documented
cases.proves: Dogpile documents Shodan's best use for infrastructure exposure and its drone-feed limitation.
cases.does_not_prove: Live Shodan API key validity or result quality.

cases.name: wayback_default_off
cases.proves: Wayback is default-off and documented as an optional archive lane.
cases.does_not_prove: Live Wayback availability for a target URL.

cases.name: readarr_default_off
cases.proves: Readarr is default-off and documented as an optional book/Usenet lane.
cases.does_not_prove: Readarr/NZB credential validity.

cases.name: ingest_website_optional_handoff
cases.proves: Website ingestion is documented as an opt-in post-search handoff.
cases.does_not_prove: Live crawl quality or Memory writes.

cases.name: automatic_synthesis_contract_documented
cases.proves: Dogpile requires synthesized, source-grounded reports instead of raw dumps only.
cases.does_not_prove: Actual synthesis quality for a live query.

cases.name: research_results_store_json_memory_doc
cases.proves: Dogpile documents and implements automatic structured JSON storage to the dogpile_research Memory collection when Memory is reachable.
cases.does_not_prove: Live Memory daemon reachability or successful storage for the current machine.
